summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by WPP plc, a foreign private issuer, for the month of May 2026. It contains standard cautionary language regarding forward-looking statements and does not report any material special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is a compliance submission under the Exchange Act with no substantive corporate action disclosed. Consequently, it does not trigger any special-situations classification.
